description.en: Gives the player a team emblem and makes it team 0's emblem, in one call: one copy of the emblem item is added to the inventory, then it is set on team 0.

true once the call has run (the emblem is set even if the ID did not match, in which case an empty emblem is set).
false if the item system is not ready.
null if the engine is not ready or no argument was given.
